messages:
dylan-peopleops: Quick thread: Sara has an IC (Jamal) approved for a band change effective 2026-06-01. Sara asked if comp can be retro to 6/1 or should we align to 6/15 payroll.
sara-engmgr: We want 6/1 if possible so offers we extend next week match internal levels. What's required to get retro in the mid-month run?
jamal-ic: Also wondering if switching bands on 6/1 affects my bonus target or benefits eligibility immediately.
dylan-peopleops: Two options: 1) Retro effective 6/1 processed on 6/15 (needs paperwork + payroll cutoff), or 2) Effective 6/15 with no retro. For retro we need manager+director approvals, completed comp change in Workday marked "retro", attach calibration note, and email hr-escalations CC payroll.
payroll-bot: Payroll reminder: to hit 2026-06-15 run, changes must be approved in Workday by 2026-06-10. Late retro requests go to 2026-07-15. For international employees allow extra lead time.
sara-engmgr: Jamal is in the US. I'll gather approvals today. Any sample wording to paste into Workday?
dylan-peopleops: Use: "Approved band change L2->L3 effective 2026-06-01. Retro pay requested for 2026-06-01 through 2026-06-14. Attached: manager approval and calibration note. Please process retro in 2026-06-15 payroll run if possible; otherwise process in 2026-07-15 and notify manager"
jamal-ic: Thanks. One more: does a level move trigger a new equity grant or reset vesting?
dylan-peopleops: Not automatically. Equity refreshes are separate approvals and grants. Existing grants keep their vesting unless a new grant is issued.
sara-engmgr: Great, I'll file by 6/09 to be safe. Thanks!
payroll-bot: Attach PDFs only. Non-PDF attachments delay processing.
